knife_edge.note: the two clippers land on OPPOSITE sides of the same half (atlas raw_pct_unsnapped vs msens raw_pct_unsnapped_msens), so pct_without_snap disagrees between the repos and pct_with_snap does not. pct_with_snap is the published number and the only one either side must reproduce.
